run_toxicchat_dataset_main: run the toxicchat dataset loader via fire CLI to print sample training data
run_toxicchat_dataset_jsonl: run the toxicchat dataset loader in JSONL mode to export prompt and label pairs
create_llamaguard_toxicchat_dataset: create a Llama Guard formatted dataset from the lmsys toxic-chat HuggingFace dataset
map_tc_categories_to_lg: map toxic chat moderation categories to Llama Guard category codes using the mapping table
tokenize_prompt_and_labels: tokenize a full prompt string into input IDs, labels, and attention mask for training
